title: What Is Meta Muse (muse.ai)? Plans, Soul.md & vs Meta AI
description: Meta Muse explained: how muse.ai differs from Meta AI, Free vs $20/$100 plans, Soul.md, Identity.md and Memory.md files, Connectors and privacy controls.
h1: What is Meta Muse? Files, plans, and how it works.
dek: How Meta's standalone personal AI agent (muse.ai) differs from Meta AI, what Free vs. $20 Power plans include, and how Soul.md, Identity.md, and Memory.md work.
lede: Meta Muse is Meta’s standalone personal AI agent on muse.ai and the Muse mobile app—separate from the Meta AI chatbot inside WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook. Each Muse runs in an isolated cloud workspace and stores your assistant’s personality, avatar, and saved context in three plain-text Markdown files: Soul.md, Identity.md, and Memory.md.
answer: Meta Muse (muse.ai and iOS/Android app) is Meta's personal AI agent with connected-app actions, scheduled Tasks, Side Chats, and three editable Markdown files: Soul.md (how it communicates with you), Identity.md (name, avatar, and voice), and Memory.md (facts saved about you). Plans include Free ($0, refreshing usage limit), Power ($20/month, 500M Muse tokens/week), and Maximum ($100/month, 3B Muse tokens/week).

sections.h2: What Muse is—and how it differs from Meta AI.
sections.html:
Here is how Meta Muse compares side by side with Meta AI:

FeatureMeta Muse (muse.ai & Muse app)Meta AI (WhatsApp, Instagram, web)
Primary rolePersistent personal agent with isolated cloud workspace, Connectors, and scheduled TasksGeneral conversational assistant inside social apps and meta.ai
Pricing & allowancesFree ($0, refreshing limit), Power ($20/mo, 500M tokens/wk), Maximum ($100/mo, 3B/wk)Included free in Meta social apps & meta.ai
Customization filesEditable Soul.md, Identity.md, and Memory.mdChat prompts and basic memory toggles; no Soul.md file system
Thread modelOne persistent Main Chat plus disposable Side ChatsStandard multi-thread chat history
Sensitive actionsConnector permissions + approval prompts for actions like email or purchases (Connector approval guide)No cloud-VM file system or Muse connector approvals

For a step-by-step comparison of tone settings across both products, see Meta AI vs. Meta Muse: how to change personality and tone.

Each user’s Muse runs in an isolated cloud virtual machine with automated backups, a separate credential store, and external permission checks. Review your account’s security settings and Meta’s permissions documentation before granting Connector access.

sections.h2: The three files: Soul.md, Identity.md, and Memory.md.
sections.html:
On both muse.ai and the iOS/Android app, tap the Assistant icon (or Profile → Personalization) → Identity to view and edit all three files:

FileWhat it controlsMenu pathDedicated guide & tool
Soul.mdCore truths, boundaries, tone, brevity, and pushback rulesAssistant icon → Identity → SoulSoul.md guide · Soul.md editor
Identity.mdDisplay name, visual avatar, spoken voice, and taglineAssistant icon → Identity → EditAvatar & Identity.md guide
Memory.mdSaved facts about you, projects, and recurring preferencesAssistant icon → Identity → MemoryMemory.md & safe reset guide

Keep formatting and tone rules inside Soul.md rather than Identity.md so changing your Muse’s avatar or name never overwrites how it talks to you. For mobile menu paths and Side Chat rules, read Meta Muse mobile menus & Side Chats vs. Main Chat.

sections.h2: Memory: what it collects and how to control it.
sections.html:
Muse builds its memory from four sources: facts you share directly, patterns it observes, context from Connectors, and Memory.md. Here are the key controls:

  • Edit or delete a memory: Tap Assistant icon → Identity → Memory and edit Memory.md, or ask in chat.
  • Forget a topic: Ask Muse in chat to forget a person, project, or topic.
  • Delete messages and Side Chats: Long-press a message or open the Side Chat menu. (Do not delete Main Chat unless you want a full account reset.)
  • Reset Muse: Settings → Data Controls → Reset Muse permanently deletes chat history, files, and active Tasks.
  • Download or import memory: Use Settings → Data Controls to download your Muse data or import a memory export (audit it first in our AI Memory Reviewer).
  • Model training toggle: Help improve our AI models starts enabled by default. Turn it off anytime under Settings → Data controls.

Prices and token allowances are from Meta’s subscription documentation.

In the supplied September 24, 2026 report for Muse Spark 1.3 (100 sequential in-session runs per test without raw vectors), Muse was reported as ISTJ in 80 of 100 MBTI runs, Type 2 (Helper) in 78 of 100 Enneagram runs, and Secure in all 100 attachment runs. Read the Muse research note for full details, or use our persistence test kit to verify Soul.md edits in your own account.

faq.a: Meta Muse is a personal AI agent available through muse.ai and its mobile app, with availability depending on location and account. It uses connected services and editable files including Soul.md, Identity.md and Memory.md. Meta lists a free usage-limited tier, Power at $20/month and Maximum at $100/month. Approval requirements depend on the action, connector and permissions you select.

faq.q: Is Muse the same as Meta AI?
faq.a: Muse has its own product interface and agent settings. This guide covers Muse’s documented files and controls; do not assume they apply to Meta AI inside other apps.

Meta lists a free tier with a usage limit. Its subscription page lists Power at $20/month with 500M Muse tokens per week and Maximum at $100/month with 3B per week. Benefits and availability can vary by account and region.
Our supplied questionnaire report names Muse Spark 1.3. That report does not independently verify which model version serves every current Muse account.

faq.q: Can Muse send email or make purchases?
faq.a: Meta documents these as examples of important actions for which Muse is designed to request approval. Requirements vary by connector, action and selected permissions. Review the proposed action and the permissions you grant.

faq.q: How do I change its communication style?
faq.a: Edit Soul.md through Assistant icon, Identity, Soul, or ask Muse to update the preference and inspect the saved text. Keep a copy of your original file and test the change on a real task.

faq.q: Can I stop training on my Muse interactions?
faq.a: Meta says Help improve our AI models is on initially. You can turn it off under Settings, Data controls. Meta says this choice also applies to previous interactions; it is separate from deleting stored files or memories.
